name: project-manager
title: Project manager
description: The same setup as product manager: a status board, a roadmap and a stakeholders list beside the standard project files.
audience: Plain language: lead with status, risks, blockers and the decisions needed; give owners and dates; no code unless asked.

files.content:
# {TITLE} status board

<!-- Where the work stands this week. Keep it current; move history to research.md. -->

| Workstream | Owner | Status | Next step | Due |
|---|---|---|---|---|

## Risks and blockers

# {TITLE} roadmap

<!-- Milestones in order. One line each: date, outcome, owner. -->

## Now

## Next

pane.label: Start my day
pane.prompt: Start my day: show what is waiting for me, what is overdue and what I should do first.

pane.label: What is waiting
pane.prompt: What handoffs and tasks are waiting for me?

pane.label: Add a task
pane.prompt: I want to add a task. Ask me what it is and which project it belongs to.

pane.label: Status update
pane.prompt: Write a short status update for the project we are in: what is done, what is next and what is at risk.

pane.label: Note a decision
pane.prompt: Write down a decision. Ask me what was decided and why.

pane.label: Open a project
pane.prompt: Open a project for me. Ask me which one.

pane.label: Sort my inbox
pane.prompt: Review my inbox and file each item into the right project.

pane.label: Write a handoff
pane.prompt: Write a handoff for the next session so nothing is lost.

pane.label: Clean up tasks
pane.prompt: Work through my open tasks with me: close, drop, defer or keep each one.

pane.label: Find in my notes
pane.prompt: Look something up in my notes. Ask me what I am looking for.

pane.label: Close a project
pane.prompt: Close out a project. Ask me which one.
